title: Canaries snap five-game losing skid with 14-3 road win against Explorers - NewsBreak
text:
By Anthony Mitchell No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
SIOUX CITY, Iowa (KCAU) – Sioux Falls tallied at least one run in seven of the nine innings, using a strong offensive performance to even the series against Sioux City with a 14-3 win over the Explorers.
The X’s collected a dozen hits, led by Zane Denton and Henry George with three apiece.
Sioux City starter Hunter Cashero allowed six runs on seven hits in 1.2 innings. The Explorers close out the series with Sioux Falls at home on Thursday at 6:35 p.m.
